chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Abi al-Mi'za, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever kills his slave intentionally, then it is upon him to free a slave, feed sixty needy persons, and fast two consecutive months.

key_terms.رَقَبَةً: a slave person to be emancipated

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for a person who intentionally kills his slave in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal expiation for a master who intentionally kills his slave. It establishes a ruling of kaffarah consisting of freeing a slave, feeding sixty needy persons, and fasting two consecutive months, reflecting the gravity of unlawful killing and the rights of others.
